## Description

Provide a clear and concise summary of the proposed changes, context, and motivation.

## Related Issues

* Closes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature modifying existing contract)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement / Refactoring

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] Backend test suite passes (`pytest tests/`)
- [ ] Frontend builds without TypeScript or JSX errors (`npm run build`)
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass locally
- [ ] Code adheres to project style guidelines (PEP 8 for Python, strict TypeScript)
- [ ] No API keys, credentials, or environment files committed
